cookie.message: We use Google Analytics to understand how this site is used. Do you agree to anonymous tracking?

ccg.alert: This tool will take your monthly digital codes and generate a PDF for you to print. One page fits 24 codes, which is 3 columns and 8 rows in Europe/A4 format.
ccg.codes_hint_base: If you paste 120 codes it will create five pages with 3 columns and 8 rows.
ccg.codes_hint_count: You have pasted {count} code(s) across {pages} page(s).
ccg.card_background_hint: Hex color (e.g. #ff0000) or upload an image. Leave empty for none. Activate background graphics in the print dialog.
ccg.print_hint: Opens your printer dialog. To save as PDF select "Save as PDF".
ccg.double_sided_hint: For double-sided printing, enable {twosided} and set flip to {longedge}.
